$comment: Generated from scripts/ai.ts. Do not edit manually.

description.description: A short description of the prompt.

name.description: The name of the prompt, used after typing / in chat. If not specified, the file name is used.

argument-hint.description: Hint text shown in the chat input field to guide users on how to interact with the prompt.

agent.description: The agent used for running the prompt: ask, agent, plan, or the name of a custom agent. By default, the current agent is used. If tools are specified, the default agent is agent.

model.description: The language model used when running the prompt. If not specified, the currently selected model in model picker is used.

tools.description: A list of tool or tool set names that are available for this prompt. Can include built-in tools, tool sets, MCP tools, or tools contributed by extensions. To include all tools of an MCP server, use the <server name>/* format.
